'''def payments_between(payments, start, end):
    """Payments created in [start, end), oldest first.

    ``start`` and ``end`` are compared against each payment's ``created_at``.
    Payments without a ``created_at`` are ignored.  Aware datetimes are
    normalised to UTC so that boundaries expressed in different timezones
    compare correctly.
    """
    start = ensure_utc(start)
    end = ensure_utc(end)
    selected = []
    for payment in payments:
        created_at = payment.created_at
        if created_at is None:
            continue
        created_at = ensure_utc(created_at)
        if start <= created_at < end:
            selected.append((created_at, payment))
    selected.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    return [payment for _, payment in selected]
''')
s = s.replace(
'from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta\n',
'from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta\n\nfrom .clock import ensure_utc\n')
p.write_text(s)
